name: Harumi no Hiyakeato
original_name: はるみの ひやけあと
source:
Ashiya Souma has been taking swimming lessons at a local swimming school since he became an adult. One reason is that he likes swimming, but another reason is that he gets to see girls in swimsuits!

And in the summer, there are more girls with clear suntan marks on their bodies.  Harumi Tose is a junior student whom Souma have taken care of since his school days, and he miss her a lot. 

When he meets her again after a long time at a swimming class, he is surprised to see how much her body has grown at once. Whether he's swimming or resting, he just can't take his eyes off her. 

All of  sudden, his junior confesses to him. Will the things he has been fantasizing about become a reality?

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page01.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
芦屋相马成年后就一直在当地的游泳学校学习游泳。一个原因是他喜欢游泳，还有一个原因是他可以看到穿泳衣的女孩！

而且到了夏天，身上有明显晒黑痕迹的女孩也越来越多。东濑晴美是相马从学生时代起就一直照顾的三年级学生，他非常想念她。

当他在游泳课上时隔许久再次见到她时，他惊讶地发现她的身体一下子长了这么多。无论是游泳还是休息，他的目光都无法从她身上移开。

突然，他的后辈向他表白了。他一直幻想的事情会成为现实吗？
